text:
maria: Heads up — release window today at 16:00 PT. Need final docs site deploy + SDK docs regen before cutoff. Who can own the docs deploy?
jonathan: I can run the deploy if someone confirms the SDK docs are regenerated and the changelog is updated.
priya: Working on SDK regen now, aim to finish by 15:10 PT. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482 — regen script ran, running unit smoke now.
lee: I'll take changelog bump + version tag once PRs are merged. Which tag format are we using for this release?
maria: Use semver tag `v1.7.0`. Add a short Console/Docs line in CHANGELOG.md referencing the SDK regen. Cutoff for merges is 15:30 PT.
priya: Regen command I used locally: ```bash
yarn workspace @redwood/sdk docs:regen && git add docs/sdk && git commit -m "docs(sdk): regen for v1.7.0"
``` Preview deployed to staging at: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/console/1.7.0 (private link).
jonathan: Docs site deploy steps for reference: 
1) merge changelog + regen PRs
2) tag main: `git tag -a v1.7.0 -m "release v1.7.0"`
3) run `./scripts/deploy-docs --env staging --tag v1.7.0`
4) verify preview, then `./scripts/deploy-docs --env production --tag v1.7.0`
(Will run step 3 once priya confirms)
sam: Deploy bot will post status when jobs start. I'll watch the pipeline and ping if anything flakes. :eyes: 
deploy-bot: CI: docs-regeneration pipeline started for PR #482. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/6667 (status: running)
lee: I'll hold off merging any console UI or docs-related PRs after 15:30 PT. If we need to late-add something critical, we can do a patch release.
maria: Quick checklist before prod flip: 
- [ ] SDK docs regen merged (priya)
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated (lee)
- [ ] Tag created (lee)
- [ ] Staging preview verified (jonathan)
- [ ] Smoke tests pass (priya + jonathan)
- [ ] Prod deploy (jonathan)
priya: Smoke tests I run: `yarn test:smoke:docs` and manual check of the SDK examples page and auth snippets. Will report back by 15:12 PT.
jonathan: If smoke passes, I'll start staging deploy at ~15:20 PT so we have time to verify before 16:00 PT prod window.
maria: Reminder to everyone — if you add any changelog lines, keep them one-sentence and under the Console > Docs section. We want concise release notes.
sam: Noted. I'll also update the release checklist ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/REL-210/release-1-7-0-checklist
priya: Smoke tests passed locally, pushing final commit now. CI is green on regen.
deploy-bot: CI: docs-regeneration pipeline succeeded for PR #482. Artifacts published.
jonathan: Staging deploy started. I'll post the preview URL once it's up.
jonathan: Preview up — https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/console/1.7.0 (smoke pages look good).
maria: Great. Priya, once you give final ack on smoke, please say so and I'll mark ready for prod.
priya: ACK smoke ✅. All examples load, no broken links in console section.
jonathan: Starting prod deploy now. Watch for deploy-bot updates.
deploy-bot: Deploy to production started for tag v1.7.0. Job 8891.
sam: I'm watching pipelines and will notify @eng if any regressions.
lee: Tag pushed: `v1.7.0` and CHANGELOG.md updated.
maria: Thanks all — flipping the release checklist to DONE. If anything unexpected, we can patch, but otherwise good to go. :tada:
jonathan: Nice work everyone.
priya: :rocket:
